# One project often drives several agents, so install writes every format
# and sync keeps them all current: Claude Code's .claude/skills, the
# vendor-neutral .skills directory (Kimi Code, OpenCode), and a managed
# block in AGENTS.md (Codex, Kimi Code).

fulcrum sync

fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
exists proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
exists proj/.skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
exists proj/AGENTS.md
grep 'BEGIN fulcrum skills' proj/AGENTS.md
grep '### corpus-writing-specs' proj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Name the behavior, not the implementation.' proj/AGENTS.md
cmp proj/.skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md
grep 'claude' proj/.fulcrum/.fulcrum-installed.json
grep 'shared' proj/.fulcrum/.fulcrum-installed.json
grep 'agents' proj/.fulcrum/.fulcrum-installed.json

# The project's own AGENTS.md prose is never touched, and re-running
# replaces the block instead of stacking copies.
cp house-rules.md proj2/AGENTS.md
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj2
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj2
grep '# House rules' proj2/AGENTS.md
grep 'Keep this paragraph.' proj2/AGENTS.md
grep -count=1 'BEGIN fulcrum skills' proj2/AGENTS.md
grep -count=1 '### corpus-writing-specs' proj2/AGENTS.md

# A later sync pushes new content into every registered project, in every
# format — no harness is left reading yesterday's skills.
srv edit skill-corpus-writing-specs 'Name the behavior, not the implementation.' 'Rewritten upstream.'
fulcrum sync
# 2 = the org's synced skill plus the client's own built-in estimating skill.
grep 'refreshed 2 skill' last-stdout.txt
grep 'Rewritten upstream.' proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep 'Rewritten upstream.' proj/.skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep 'Rewritten upstream.' proj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Rewritten upstream.' proj2/AGENTS.md

# A project that has moved away is forgotten rather than nagged about.
rm proj2
fulcrum sync
! grep 'proj2' last-stderr.txt

# --target narrows it; auto writes only what the project already uses.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/onlyclaude --target claude
exists onlyclaude/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
! exists onlyclaude/AGENTS.md
fulcrum skills install $WORK/onlyclaude --target auto
! exists onlyclaude/AGENTS.md

fulcrum -code 2 skills install $WORK/proj --target sublime
grep 'unknown target' last-stderr.txt
grep 'claude, shared, agents' last-stderr.txt

-- proj2/.keep --
-- house-rules.md --
# House rules

Keep this paragraph.
